item.title: Sustainable Energy Solutions for Low-Carbon and Smart Mobility
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on sustainable energy approaches and technologies that enable low-carbon and intelligent mobility systems. The collection seeks to advance understanding of how energy solutions can reduce transportation emissions while supporting smart mobility innovations and infrastructure development.

Appel publié par Transport Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
